newsitem.title: TURKEY: Floods in Turkey paralyse parts of Istanbul.
newsitem.headline: Floods in Turkey paralyse parts of Istanbul.

text.p: Floods paralysed low-lying parts of Istanbul on Tuesday and emergency services worked to rescue people cut off by the rising waters, witnesses said.

Thirty-two workers at a chemical factory in the Istanbul district of Kagithane were stranded overnight after a failed attempt by armoured personnel carriers to rescue them, Anatolian news agency said.
Officials said they were assessing damage caused by muddy water which inundated many streets after heavy rains began on Sunday night.
"Around 300 houses were flooded. The value of the damage is being evaluated," Istanbul governor Kutlu Aktas was quoted as saying by Anatolian.
